contents: Still photos with multiple faces; GAN-synthesized identities placed into real photos. Per-face genuine/forged labels, boxes, masks and landmarks. Some photos contain both genuine and forged faces.
access: Public Zenodo download links; no author-approval gate shown. Repository restricts use to academic purposes.
size: Smallest image archive 2.0 GB; Val.zip 3.1 GB plus 121.7 MB annotations. Do not retrieve full archives for smoke.

verified_small_access.observation: Two bounded 64-KiB reads verified HTTP ranges, ZIP directory metadata and Val/<id>.jpg filenames. Selective member extraction appears feasible; image payload extraction is untested.

proposed_smoke: 4 genuine + 4 forged face crops from distinct source photos; predetermined ADM/k7/rep0 baseline and augmented heads, seed17. No retraining.
annotation_gate: Verify official category mapping and genuine/forged labels before constructing an image manifest. Stop on ambiguity.
proposed_crop: One square crop centered on annotated face box, side 1.2*max(width,height), clipped to image. Reject genuine crops intersecting any forged region. Record exact crop coordinates and actual saved bytes SHA256; all model groups use identical crops.
proposed_later_evaluation: 50 genuine + 50 forged crops from distinct source-image groups, separate from smoke; clean only. Freeze seeded membership and hashes before predictions. Group known related identities/photos; disclose unresolved identity overlap.
metrics: Image-level AUROC, accuracy@0.5, fake recall, real false-positive rate, fake F1, confusion counts; no video aggregation.
checkpoint_plan: Two heads for smoke; all 48 k=7 ViT heads only after agreement. CNN corresponding checkpoints and multimodal subset require owner coordination.
scope: Transfer to this GAN-based face replacement workflow; cannot establish detection of every face manipulation or video deepfake.
blockers: Small labeled crop extraction not yet verified
No local CLIP/checkpoint weights found; CARC hostname resolution failed
Dataset and final crop protocol await agreement
